name: Asuma Heita
source:
3rd year high school student. An 'Aburasumashi' youkai.
An aimless guy who doesn't care about people's status or blood-line.
Oil is his favorite dish and he drinks it no matter what.
He's on good terms with the protagonist, but when they get close it's like literally 'adding fuel to the fire' and bad things always end up happening.
